requirementText: We require a heavy-duty belt conveyor system for our two-wheeler assembly plant in Dharuhera. The conveyor should handle 400kg per meter load, run at 2 m/s, and cover approximately 40 meters. SS304 material preferred. Motor drives should be VFD controlled.

Automated packaging line required for biscuit products. Target throughput 100 packs per minute. Needs vision-based quality inspection, PLC automation with SCADA, and integration with our existing ERP. GMP compliant.
500T hydraulic press requirement for our Vijayanagar plant. Metal sheet forming application. Need full safety certification and CE marking.
Robotic welding cell for car door panel assembly. 6-axis robot preferred, MIG welding, cycle time under 60 seconds. Full safety fencing and light curtains required.
Battery module assembly line for electric vehicle production. Requires laser welding for cell tabs, automated testing (OCV, IR), and cleanroom-compatible design. Output: 500 modules/day.
50-tonne EOT crane for steel plant bay, span 28m, lift height 18m. FEM 2m class. PLC operated with radio remote, anti-collision system, and load weighing.
Automated test rig for common rail diesel injectors. Test parameters: injection quantity, back-leak, flow rate. 100% inspection at 2000 bar test pressure. Throughput 300 injectors/shift.
Agitated reactor vessel 5000L for specialty chemical synthesis. SS316L, jacketed heating/cooling, PTFE lined agitator, explosion-proof motor, full DCS integration.
Electrostatic paint application system for passenger car body-in-white. Conveyorised, 3 coat 3 bake process, throughput 30 JPH. Oven temperature uniformity ±5°C.
High-shear mixing system for interior emulsion paint production. Batch size 8000L, inline pigment dispenser, automatic viscosity measurement, CIP system, SS316L wetted parts.
Cold-chamber die casting machine 400T for crankcase production. Shot sleeve diameter 80mm, cycle time under 40 seconds, integrated trim press, robotic part extraction.
High-pressure gas scrubber for offshore platform topside module. Design pressure 150 bar, design temperature -20 to 150°C, 36-inch diameter, ASME Sec VIII Div 2, subsea rated materials.
Engine test cell for BS6 heavy commercial vehicle engines up to 400kW. Water-cooled eddy current dynamometer, automated fuel measurement, emissions measurement as per AIS 137, PLC controlled.
Perforated pan tablet coater 600kg batch capacity for aqueous film coating. Inlet/outlet air handling with HEPA filtration, 8 spray guns, automated end-point detection, 21 CFR Part 11 compliant HMI.

800T progressive stamping press for A-pillar and B-pillar components. Servo feed system, quick die change under 10 minutes, in-die sensing, integrated vision inspection, Industry 4.0 ready OPC-UA interface.
11kV motor control center for 220MW thermal power plant auxiliary systems. 56 feeder modules, numerical protection relays, IEC 61850 GOOSE messaging, integrated energy metering.
Redundant PLC-based control system for refinery distillation unit. 3200 I/O points, SIL 2 safety system, SCADA with historian, OPC-UA connectivity, cybersecurity as per IEC 62443.
Shell and tube heat exchanger for crude oil preheating duty in refinery. Heat duty 12 MW, shell ID 1050mm, 2-pass tube side, IBR compliance, NACE MR0175 materials, TEMA R class.
